verified_facts.text: The resort sits between the tropical jungle and the Caribbean Sea in the Riviera Maya.
verified_facts.excerpt: Between the tropical jungle and the Caribbean Sea, the festive season at Rosewood Mayakoba reveals the holidays through an unmistakably Riviera Maya lens.

verified_facts.text: Accommodation is in villas and suites set by the lagoon, the beach and the jungle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Villas and suites by lagoon, beach and jungle, crafted to seamlessly blend with the nature.

verified_facts.text: Beachfront Suites are located directly on the sand, steps from the ocean, with sunset views.
verified_facts.excerpt: unobstructed sunset views—located directly on the sand only steps from the ocean.

verified_facts.text: Lagoon Suites overlook Mayakoba's winding lagoons and mangrove jungle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking the beauty of Mayakoba’s winding lagoons and lush mangrove jungle, Lagoon Suites provide a private haven to escape the everyday.

verified_facts.text: Oceanview Suites are two-story and three-story units on the beachside area of the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: These expansive two-story and three-story Playa Del Carmen accommodations provide the ideal escape and are located on the beachside area of the resort.

verified_facts.text: La Ceiba Garden & Kitchen serves Mayan-inspired flavors at a communal table under a Ceiba tree.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gather at a communal table under a majestic Ceiba tree for a celebration of Mayan-inspired flavors.

verified_facts.text: Agave Azul is a Northern Baja California seafood restaurant with Asian influences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Northern Baja California seafood restaurant with Asian influences.

verified_facts.text: Punta Bonita serves Mexican flavors with panoramic views of the Caribbean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the culinary traditions and diverse heritage of Mexican flavors, punctuated with panoramic views of the Caribbean.

verified_facts.text: Casa Del Lago serves tropical breakfast in the traditional style of Central Mexico.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tropical breakfast in the traditional style of Central Mexico.

verified_facts.text: Pan Dulce is a bakery in the El Pueblito village square drawing on panaderia traditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Centuries-old panadería traditions inform the sweet and savory creations of this not-to-be-missed bakery in Mayakoba’s El Pueblito village square.

verified_facts.text: La Fondita is an indoor-outdoor restaurant inspired by Mexico City's neighborhood cantinas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by Mexico City's neighborhood cantinas, this charming indoor-outdoor restaurant

verified_facts.text: Zapote Bar is a cocktail bar serving food made with local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cocktail bar offering gracious service and inspired food with local ingredients.

verified_facts.text: The El Camaleon golf course runs through Mayakoba from tropical jungle to the oceanfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: El Camaleón meanders through the lush landscape of Mayakoba, from tropical jungle to pristine Riviera Maya oceanfront.

verified_facts.text: The Mayakoba Dive & Water Sports Center offers experiences on the Caribbean Sea and its barrier reef.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience Mexico's Caribbean Sea and the world's second-largest barrier reef with the Mayakoba Dive & Water Sports Center.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers kids' menus, special events and activities for families.
verified_facts.excerpt: From kids' menus to special events and fun activities, the kid-friendly resort in Mexico aims to provide family-centric vacations for all.
